decision: Announced identity-only successor for the root Cargo.lock change from RNK-11 (#463: the vendored candle-core makes tokenizers optional behind an off-by-default quantized-tokenizer feature, removing 21 lock entries (580 to 559 packages), among them the onig, onig_sys and esaxx-rs C closure), after the telemetry lockfile identity. No crates/feat-math source changes; only Cargo.lock's hash, the implementation_sha256 and identity digest it feeds, and both fixtures' generated_at_sha move. All behavior fixtures, lineage source hashes, historical-v1 objects and earlier transition ledgers remain byte-identical.
plan_reference: JopeDime v1 master plan RNK-11 (Remove C from the CPU closure); identity transition added under owner instruction merge_0450 because the PR changed Cargo.lock without one, failing feat-math::compat_freeze; ADR-0004
